summary: fix(queue): allow loopback HTTP in pytest verification sandbox and enforce multi-file patch completeness

delivery.outcome: Allow isolated loopback HTTP servers in pytest verification sandbox while blocking AF_UNIX sockets via seccomp, scale context assembly for multi-file specs, and report untouched target files on multi-file verification retries.
nonGoals: Do not weaken read-only filesystem or AF_UNIX socket isolation in verification_sandbox.py

architecture.decision: Use libseccomp seccomp_rule_add_array with scmp_arg_cmp(arg0 == AF_UNIX) on socket during pytest verification runs inside bwrap --unshare-all so loopback AF_INET/AF_INET6 servers work while host AF_UNIX sockets remain blocked; scale multi-file context budgets in context.py; and union declared ticket files in _pin_base while surfacing untouched files in build_verify_retry_prompt.

validation.evidence: Unit tests for loopback HTTP pytest verification, AF_UNIX denial, multi-file context scaling, and incomplete multi-file retry prompts.
